preconditions.description: The domain size n is an integer between 1 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(f_values) == n and all(1 <= v <= n for v in f_values)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n integers representing the function values, each within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: k == min(k_val for k_val in range(1, n + 1) if all(f_k(f_k(x, k_val, f_values), k_val, f_values) == f_k(x, k_val, f_values) for x in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output k is the minimum positive integer such that applying the function k times results in an idempotent function, meaning f(k)(f(k)(x)) = f(k)(x) for all x in the domain.
